import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        List<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<>();
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            
            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                int cost = Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
                costs.add(cost);
                even = 0;
                odd = 0;
            }
        }
        
        Collections.sort(costs);
        
        int maxCuts = 0;
        int currentCost = 0;
        for (int cost : costs) {
            if (currentCost + cost <= btcAmount) {
                currentCost += cost;
                maxCuts++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxCuts);
    }
}
